name: Letter
long_description: The Internet is changing. The median website visitor is no longer a human ... it's an agent. Letterpress-1 is the world's first coding agent built for the future of the agentic internet. First, it handles issues of the past: website expansion, SEO/GEO, de-anonymization, inbound conversion, etc. Then, it tackles the biggest problem of the future: evidence creation for agents. Letterpress-1 harnesses Letter, an infrastructure platform with DNS, servers, sandboxes, and databases. With over 100+ customers and thousands of pull requests, Letterpress-1 is slowly reshaping the Internet, sitemap by sitemap.
one_liner: The coding agent and IDE for the agentic internet
